verdict.rationale: Baseten ships its own client libraries: the Performance Client sends concurrent requests from Python, JavaScript, or Rust, and the community account of a Rust-based, GIL-releasing client corroborates it. Truss is an official Python package and CLI for packaging and deploying models, and Loops exposes training as API calls from Python. Its OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints let developers reuse familiar client SDKs, but those are third-party SDKs and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose official SDK for inference and workspace management, an SDK reference beyond one-line mentions, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).
